lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2064. A glass atrium with a ticker running the length of it, and four buildings behind it that nobody who works here has ever been inside.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Thirty-three years and it has grown a lobby. The lab is still back there. It is just nobody's job to go in any more.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: This is the counterparty. The actual one, with a floor and a receptionist. Article nine assigns custody to this address.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ticker is running allocation figures for regions that have not been called regions since before you were born.
